g.text: KayaRank3Convo1 begins.
I just realized who you remind me of.
A student I got paired with in first year at uni.
Check boolean KayaCake
Uh oh. In a good way?
true
An incredibly attractive and brilliant student?
false
I'm bracing for this to not start a fight...
false
Yes actually.
Ew. Hate to break it to you but I don't flirt. Ever.
Omg please, no, no. This is a happy memory.
I was baking a cake to prove you wrong.
ESPECIALLY not on the internet.
If you say so.
You don't seem to have many of those.
And it made me think about the only time someone baked a cake for me was this shy classmate.
But what if I wanted to?
Woah my bad. My bad.
It's about my birthday actually, but it's not about me.
Let me share one then!
Who somehow found out it was my birthday despite me like never being seen with them.
It'll never be with me.
Don't try it again.
Well like I guess a bit it was. I should say that um I definitely was the type of person that everyone wanted to be seen with.
And they brought me a vanilla cake with vanilla icing, the cake was like three layers tall I swear.
+5 Chemistry
I promise I wont.
Good grades, beyond good actually. And captain of the cheer-force. It was like a big deal to get invited to my birthday party.
Anyway, I saw them with the cake. And I was so worried to have the class see them give ME a cake. We did NOT hang out with the same crowd.
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank3Convo2.
Update boolean KayaFlirtPromise
Anyway, this student baked me a birthday cake but told me not to share it with anyone and to wait until I got home to eat it.
I had good grades. Beyond good actually. And captain of the cheer-force. It was like a big deal to get invited to my birthday party.
Fine.
And to be honest it weirded me out, kind of like you did at first. But then I cut it open and my kitchen knife hit something hard.
Gross right? Mega gross. But then I looked and it was like a plastic container they hid under the cake filled with sealed Jinymon Card packs. My favourite things ever.

But a girl like me would not be caught DEAD with those at school. But obviously this shy kid saw what I was really like and snuck me the real gift while making it look like they wanted my attention with a big cake or something idk.
I'm not baking you a cake.
For someone who is supposed to be some kid genius you really take a while to make a point...
And how does that remind you of me exactly?
+20 Chemistry
And for someone from the great and inspiring future you sure missed the point. Jinymon Cards! ME! Can you believe it?
I guess in my own way I'm saying I think I trust you with letting you know I collect Jinymon Cards. They are kind of for losers.
Haaahaha!
I have no idea what those are!
Are they like, special collectors items?
Or at least I thought. But the real losers were everyone else.
It'd probably be gross anyway.
They're like a kids monster card game and totally kind of for losers, especially in university.
Maybe you'll show me your Jinymon Cards one day?
Wow, we finished a whole conversation without ONLY talking about time travel!
Is this you opening up to me? Refreshing!
You're probably right.
I could figure it out.
Maybe.
Tada!
Don't get used to it. Maybe. Ugh IDK.
Yeahhh yeahh!
+20 Chemistry
I guess in my own way I'm saying I think I trust you with letting you know I collect Jinymon Cards. They are kind of for losers.
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank3Convo2.
Or at least I thought. But the real losers were everyone else.
